item.description:
Aki 0.14.2

Fixed

  • Mark right away: press ⇧⌘A and click or drag at once, and it counts as marking. In the instant before marking was up, it went to the page below and selected its text.
  • Sharper outline on web pages: what's outlined is what the pointer is in, a card or a grid's cell, not the button a few pixels beside it. And when the pointer stops right after moving, the outline catches up with where it is.
  • Type in the app below while marking: ⇧-click into an address bar or a search box and what you type goes there (the screen is captured again once you stop). Click on the marking to go back to it.

Aki 0.14.2-beta.3

Fixed

  • Mark right away: press ⇧⌘A and click or drag at once, and it counts as marking. In the instant before marking was up, it went to the page below and selected its text.
  • Sharper outline on web pages: what's outlined is what the pointer is in, a card or a grid's cell, not the button a few pixels beside it.
  • Type in the app below while marking: ⇧-click into an address bar or a search box and what you type goes there.

Aki 0.14.1

Fixed

  • Lighter on your Mac: Aki now uses about a quarter of the processor it did while idle. Token use is counted again only from the logs macOS says changed, session files are reread only when they change, and the sidebar rests while the screen sleeps or is locked.
  • ⇧⌘A outlines right away what is under the pointer: it used to wait for the mouse to move.
  • An area's picture is just that area: it used to take in a bit around it, often the lines above and below.

Aki 0.14.0

New

  • + New on the marking card: no terminal open yet? Open Claude or Codex in a new Orca tab, or a new conversation in the Claude or Codex app, in the project you pick, with your marks as its first message.
  • Pick several marks in History: tick the box at the start of each row (shift-click ticks every mark in between), then send them all to one session, mark them done or delete them together.
